# Ceylon JOJO Travels

> Private Sri Lanka tours with local chauffeur drivers, custom itineraries, and holiday packages.

Ceylon JOJO Travels is a Sri Lanka tour operator offering private day tours and multi-day round tours with hotel stays and private transportation.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ceylonjojotravels.com/en): Private Sri Lanka tours overview
- [Tour packages](https://ceylonjojotravels.com/en/tours): Day tours and multi-day itineraries
- [About us](https://ceylonjojotravels.com/en/about-us): Company story and team
- [Services](https://ceylonjojotravels.com/en/our-services): Chauffeur, guides, and travel services
- [Destinations](https://ceylonjojotravels.com/en/destinations): Sigiriya, Ella, Kandy, Galle, Yala and more
- [Contact](https://ceylonjojotravels.com/en/contact): Book or enquire via WhatsApp, phone, or email
- [Testimonials](https://ceylonjojotravels.com/en/customer-testimonials): Guest reviews
- [Travel guides](https://ceylonjojotravels.com/en/travel-guides): Meet our chauffeur guides and practical Sri Lanka travel tips
